purpose: Actionable SF5 recipe guidance for component hints detected in Tailwind snippets. Recipes are advisory and do not rewrite source HTML automatically.

recipes.title: Authentication Form Recipe
conversionSteps: Preserve the form action, method, field names, labels, aria attributes, and submit behavior.
Replace utility-only layout wrappers with the auth page recipe structure.
Map inputs to source-backed SF5 input patterns only after confirming project custom-element usage.
Keep validation messages inline and close to the field that owns them.
manualChecks: Confirm auth flow type: login, registration, reset, or invite.
Confirm whether password managers and browser autofill require native input fallback.
Run visual QA on error, disabled, loading, and success states.

recipes.title: Static Card Recipe
conversionSteps: Preserve the source semantic container: article, section, li, or div according to context.
Use SF5 surface, border, radius, spacing, and shadow utilities for static cards.
Do not infer interactive behavior unless source markup has explicit button, link, or data hooks.
Promote repeated cards to a component scaffold only after at least two repeated instances are present.
recipes.starterMarkup:
Card title

Supporting text
manualChecks: Check whether the card is static, clickable, selectable, or a list item.
Check if image/media slots require an SF5 media or gallery pattern.
Run visual QA for radius and shadow scale.

recipes.title: Data Table Recipe
conversionSteps: Preserve table semantics: table, thead, tbody, tr, th, td, scope, and aria attributes.
Wrap wide tables in an overflow container before adding smart behavior.
Route filters, sorting, pagination, and bulk actions to pattern playbooks instead of guessing JS behavior.
Keep row actions explicit and verify keyboard navigation separately.
recipes.starterMarkup:
Column
Value
manualChecks: Confirm whether the table is static, sortable, filterable, selectable, or paginated.
Confirm empty, loading, and error states.

recipes.title: Toolbar Recipe

route.scaffoldCommand: python3 skills/sf5/scripts/generate_sf5_working_set.py "catalog listing with filters and toolbar" --out-dir /tmp/sf5-toolbar

conversionSteps: Preserve buttons, links, search inputs, filter controls, labels, and data hooks.
Use SF5 flex, wrapping, gap, and main-axis content utilities for responsive toolbar layout.
Do not collapse filters into a smart component until source behavior is explicit.
Keep primary and secondary actions visually distinct.
manualChecks: Confirm primary action and destructive actions.
Check wrapping and control order on mobile.
Confirm whether search/filter changes are immediate or submit-based.
